entities.summary: Philip II, a notable figure in the history of Spain, associated with Habsburg Spain & the Global Empire (1556–1598). Preceded by Dutch Revolt and Hernán Cortés conquers the Aztec Empire. Their legacy influenced Battle of Lepanto – Christian fleet defeats Ottoman navy and Spanish Armada defeated by England.
